title: Needs to be bigger!
text: Needs to be bigger!. I like how stylish this bread container is, but I was pretty disappointed with how small it is. It would not fit a loaf of bread without having to squish the bread. I usually have a variety of bread items and would need two to three of these to comfortably fit everything.

product_metadata.title: Baking & Beyond Bread Box with Bamboo Cutting Board Lid,13"x7.5"x5" Space-Saving Bread Box for Kitchen Countertop, Bread Storage Container Holder, Bread Keeper Bin - Fresh Loaves
